scope.frame: B1656's four-channel coupling on the punctured torus E_tau at B1667's canonical end
scope.object: the regularized channel norms c_s^(sec)(tau, w) across sectors and the boundary-norm dressing (2*pi*L + c_s)^alpha of v_DR against B1757's free-doublet vectors on the strip
scope.hypotheses: SU(5) hypercharge assignments (1,-4), (1,2), (-3,6) with x_s + y_s = +/- 3w

claim_one_line: SECTOR-UNIVERSAL PUNCTURE NORM THEOREM AND BOUNDARY-DRESSED HIGGS PROBE (P-357, P-366, P-377): for every SM sector (q_L, q_R), the normalized elliptic channel kernel K_s(u; x, y) = P_s(u; x, y)/R_s(x, y) depends only on x + y = +/- 3w, so c_s^(up)(tau, w) = c_s^(down)(tau, w) = c_s^(lep)(tau, w) identically across M_{1,2} (certified to <= 4.3e-13 on the strip). Boundary-norm dressing (2*pi*L + c_s)^alpha lifts v_DR off the null cone at the B1757 scale O(10^-2) (I(+1/2) in [0.010, 0.015], I(+1) in [0.019, 0.029]), while exact 2-torsion of 5w forces R_i^(up) = 0 identically on order-10 lines. 0 of 19.
weave_or_thread: weave (exact identity on M_{1,2} and strip probe)
summary: Proves Theorem 1 (Sector-Universal Puncture Norm Theorem, P-357 Step 2): for every SM sector (q_L, q_R), the normalized elliptic channel kernel K_s(u; x, y) = P_s(u; x, y)/R_s(x, y) depends only on x + y = +/- 3w, so c_s^(up)(tau, w) = c_s^(down)(tau, w) = c_s^(lep)(tau, w) identically across M_{1,2} (certified to <= 4.3e-13 on the strip). Establishes Theorem 2 (off-cone scale vs. sector splitting against B1757): boundary-norm dressing (2*pi*L + c_s)^alpha lifts v_DR off the null cone at the B1757 scale O(10^-2) (I(+1/2) in [0.010, 0.015], I(+1) in [0.019, 0.029]), while exact 2-torsion of 5w forces R_i^(up) = 0 identically on order-10 lines.
